name: BIDMC Congestive Heart Failure Database
description: The BIDMC Congestive Heart Failure Database is a physiological time series collection compiled by Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and Harvard Medical School. It includes 15 continuous long-term Holter ECG recordings (each approximately 20 hours in duration, sampled at 250 Hz) from 15 subjects (11 men, aged 22 to 71; and 4 women, aged 54 to 63) suffering from severe chronic congestive heart failure (NYHA functional class III–IV). The collection has served as a benchmark for studying heart rate turbulence, non-linear interbeat interval dynamics, and sudden cardiac death risk stratification.
